product_metadata.title: Chef Buddy AF031006 Pancake Batter Dispenser, 24 oz, Stainless Steel
features: Pour batter like a pro!: Get ready for the griddle! You don’t need to be a pro to make everyday breakfast, snacks, or desserts! Chef Buddy Pancake Batter Dispenser promises even distribution of batter no matter what you're cooking. This batter pourer helps you easily pour out batters and sauces mess-free! Create perfect-looking pancakes, waffles, muffins, cupcakes, crepes, and more!

No More Messy Drips Or Spills!: Time to get rid of messy scoops and bowls! Chef Buddy Pancake Batter Dispenser features a wide mouth opening plus a no-drip nozzle with the stopper to prevent drips and leaks - no more messy splatters, wasted batters! A great kitchen tool for kids who enjoy cooking or baking, too!

Multipurpose Batter Dispenser: Pour out the perfect amount of batters to your baking pans, cupcake liners, or molder for a hassle-free baking experience! This baking accessory can also be used for sauces, frostings, pancake mix, cake mix, muffin mix, cupcake mix, crepes or waffle batter even gravy or pizza sauce! Perfect baking accessory for any cooking/baking enthusiast!

High-Quality Stainless Steel: This batter pourer is made from a food-grade, lightweight, long-lasting, sturdy, handy stainless steel baking tool with a scratch-resistant design for long-term use. It is safe, odorless, and healthy to use, too! A must-have addition to your kitchen tool collection that will surely last for years!

Easy to Use, Easy to Clean: Make your pancake-prepping process so much faster and easier! Features a grippy handle to help you keep your grip and an easy-to-use spring-release trigger to dispense the batter onto your hot griddle or pan. Easy peasy! To clean, wash it by hand and let it dry after each use.
description: Make pancakes in a breeze with no more messy drips or spills! Chef Buddy Pancake Batter Dispenser helps you effortlessly create perfect-looking pancakes, waffles, muffins, or cupcakes. Not only that! This batter pourer helps load up cupcake tins, create truffles, or even ice sugar cookies!

Sturdy, long-lasting, handy stainless steel baking tool that holds up to 24 ounces of batter with a wide mouth opening and no-drip nozzle making portion control easy and mess-free - no more messy splatters nor wasted batters for you! Just squeeze the trigger to get the batter to come out the bottom and the valve closes tight to keep the batter from dripping. A great baking tool companion in making your family’s everyday breakfast, snacks, or desserts like a pro!
Equipped with: spring-loaded handle, with an open and close dispenser nozzle
